entities.summary: Dalvin Tomlinson is an American professional football nose tackle for the Los Angeles Chargers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide. He was selected by the New York Giants in the second round of the 2017 NFL draft, and played for the team from 2017 to 2020.
